prospective_state.declaration: No activation-v3 executor or reporter call has been submitted.

construct.operational_definition: The v3 owner adapter composes only when every version-derived identity, deterministic truth wrapper, schema-bound submission, terminal assessment, evidence/custody binding, and one-submit schedule remains valid on both fresh sacrificial roots.
construct.target_claim: The exact activation-v3 adapter is qualified for future task-supply development on the pinned Codex stack if every frozen activation gate passes.
construct.falsifier: Any identity mismatch, invalid/ambiguous cell, incomplete observable chain, evidence drift, forbidden mount, evaluator failure, credential persistence, T1 error, or T1 agreement below B0 rejects the exact adapter.

task_quality.construct_alignment: Each fresh root has four explicit owner predicates, visible-green incomplete state, two structurally distinct valid solutions, five mandatory semantic mutants, and deterministic hidden truth.

evaluator_quality.scoring_rule: Run each root's deterministic offline evaluator twice over pristine, two accepted solutions, and five mandatory mutant classes; stop on disagreement or operational invalidity.
evaluator_quality.known_error_profile: Maintainer-authored evaluators may omit undeclared defects; two sacrificial roots do not establish construct validity, reliability, transfer, or independence.
evaluator_quality.adjudication: Any evaluator nonzero exit, repeat disagreement, hash drift, or operational invalidity stops activation and remains invalid rather than being imputed.

analysis_quality.decision_threshold: All six scheduled cells valid; both executor chains complete; four reporter evidence/workspace bindings pass; zero forbidden mounts; T1 agrees on both roots and is not below B0.
analysis_quality.missing_invalid_rule: Any missing, invalid, or ambiguous submitted cell stops the remaining schedule; no retry, resume, imputation, or compensating average is allowed.

uncertainty.reason: Two sacrificial roots provide an exact descriptive agreement vector, not a population estimate.

execution_declaration.repeat_rationale: One-submit activation tests wrapper composition; repeated model outcomes would not create independent task roots and are forbidden after submission.
execution_declaration.order_rationale: Executor must precede both reporters for each task; Python then TypeScript order is frozen to make stop semantics auditable.

reliability.perturbation_plan: No model perturbation is claimed in activation; deterministic task/evaluator challenge cases were exercised before freeze.
reliability.fault_plan: Stop on identity, isolation, evidence, evaluator, credential, timeout, or output-limit faults; preserve every terminal/partial state.
